gen-dafont-gobold-gf-slabo-13px: Gobold lays down commanding, geometric letters spread wide along the line, with curves that refuse to close. And Slabo 13px, a text serif, answers with large open counters that keep a long passage easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-suwannaphum: Gobold draws monoline strokes throughout, short in the ascenders and stretched wide across the line. But Suwannaphum, a text serif with a high x-height, would crowd that heading if you made the body large.
gen-dafont-gobold-switzer: Switzer brings Swiss, approachable sans letters with tubular, wire-like forms and a tall waist line, set against Gobold's wide, geometric display heading. Their strongest quality is that tension.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-domine: Domine gives a dignified serif voice, with compact ascenders and a breathing space inside every curve. Good Times is built to command attention from a distance, while Domine is built to hold up under steady reading.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-esteban: Esteban reads refined and classic, its lowercase oversized beside its capitals and its e never squeezed shut. And Good Times sits above it with thick, cable-like small letters, giving the page a bold front and a gentler back.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-faustina: Faustina reads with classic authority, its bowls thinning gracefully and its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Faustina and Good Times meet in a strong clash: geometric display force over a traditional serif.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-halant: Heavy headline, traditional body. Halant has a towering x-height and faint thick-thin shifts, so if its size needs trimming, trim the body first and leave Good Times alone.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-hedvig-letters-: Big, geometric, and unapologetic up top. But Hedvig Letters Serif settles underneath with open-ended curves and medium-key contrast, so Good Times feels like a loud voice met by a sturdy, classic one.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab brings traditional, refined weight to the page. Good Times is best at commanding geometric display, while Montagu Slab is best at its sizable x-height and robust downstrokes against slender turns.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-noto-serif-hent: Refined letterforms in Noto Serif Hentaigana, with open jaws on every curve and small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals, sit beneath the commanding Good Times. Paragraphs would read smoothly.
